summary: The registered Windows runner completed the Flutter workflow, including a Windows Release build. The CI setup now creates and validates junctions for Windows plugin packages whose CMake projects are required by Flutter.

checks.name: Windows runner dispatch and Flutter setup
checks.observation: GitVerse assigned the job to boohtacord-win-station, verified Flutter 3.47.5, and resolved dependencies from the committed lockfile.

checks.name: Windows plugin junction preparation
checks.observation: The workflow completed its plugin-link step, creating Windows junctions from .flutter-plugins-dependencies where a package contains windows/CMakeLists.txt.

checks.name: Flutter tests and analyzer on Windows runner
checks.observation: The test step completed in 27 seconds and analysis in 9 seconds; neither failed the job.

checks.name: Windows Release build
checks.observation: The flutter build windows --release step completed and the overall GitVerse job finished successfully in 3 minutes 36 seconds.

checks.name: Windows app runtime and visual acceptance
checks.observation: A successful CI build proves compilation only; launching the artifact and comparing native behavior/screenshots against web were not performed.

remaining: Run the built Windows client and verify key workflows, screen/window capture, attachment clipboard/save, audio devices and matched screenshots against web.
